critical_code_review_comments: Biblia.jsx is 532 lines and combines reader, selection bar, two pickers and the study drawer. Splitting it (e.g., SelectionBar, StudyDrawer subcomponents) would help maintainability but is not blocking.
ErrorBoundary.jsx correctly resets via resetKey when selection changes — implementation is clean and aligned with what was requested.

Aula.jsx iframe uses key={embed}; since all 21 aulas now share the same video URL, the iframe key won't change between aulas — that is intentional per current spec but may cause the YouTube player to NOT reset between aulas (autoplay state retained). Acceptable today; flag if business asks for distinct videos later.
Drawer description region for selected verses scrolls (max-h-32) which is good for many-verse selections.

No flakes observed; 0 console errors during the entire flow.
